title: eupatorium album var. petaloideum
intro: Eupatorium album var. petaloideum, commonly known as White Snakeroot, is a plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, aiding in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of White Snakeroot include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
